summary: Iter-42 Phase-3 Batch B: Advance Settlement Module + Payroll Auto-Deduction fully verified. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass on /app/backend/tests/test_iter42_settlement_payroll.py — covers all 4 settle types (cash_repayment, write_off, salary_deduction, manual_adjustment), 403 for non-finance user, 401 for anon, 404 unknown adv, 422 amount<=0, 400 amount>balance, /api/staff/{sid}/open-advances (200 for admin, 403 for staff), payroll auto-pre-fill of `advance` + `advance_deductions_details` (scheduled reason preferred), and PATCH /payroll/{pid}/pay reducing advance balance + appending salary_deduction settlement w/ payroll_id + txn_id + clearing pending_salary_deduction. Regression: /api/transactions, /api/advance-requests, /api/payroll (advance field is numeric), /api/advance-requests/reroute-pending — all still 200. Frontend: /advances page shows emerald Settle button (data-testid adv-settle-<id>) on 6 released/adjusting rows; Settle modal (settle-modal) opens with amount (settle-amount) pre-filled to full balance, dynamic type description, live 'Balance after this settlement' preview, remarks field (settle-remarks). Submit posts /settle, toast 'settled | Balance ₹…' fires, modal closes.

minor.issue: When payroll net<=0 (e.g. zero-attendance month) the endpoint marks payroll paid but SKIPS the advance-deduction loop entirely. The `advance` field on the payroll row and the linked advance's pending_salary_deduction therefore remain untouched, and the audit trail is not written. HR could accidentally 'close' a payroll and lose the scheduled deduction. Consider either (a) running the deduction loop even when net<=0, or (b) refusing to pay a payroll whose gross+advance still leaves a positive due amount.

TransactionOut pydantic model does not include the settlement-linking fields (is_advance_settlement, is_advance_writeoff, advance_request_id, advance_no, settlement_id). They persist correctly in DB but are stripped from the API response, so the frontend cannot filter/badge settlement txns without extra queries. Suggest adding these Optional fields to TransactionOut.

issues: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications overlay flashes briefly on chart-heavy pages — benign but noisy in dev overlay. Consider wrapping chart containers with a debounced ResizeObserver polyfill or suppress this warning in production build.

action_items: (minor) Fix payroll_pay early-return for net<=0 so scheduled advance deductions are still consumed and audit-logged.
(minor) Expose is_advance_settlement / is_advance_writeoff / advance_request_id / advance_no fields on TransactionOut so the ledger UI can label them.
critical_code_review_comments: settle_advance uses `balance <= 0.01` guard which correctly treats near-zero rounding as settled.
advance-deduction loop in payroll_pay uses `min(det.amount, cur_bal)` — safely caps if the balance shrank after payroll_run.

Both settle_advance and payroll_pay update settlements[] via read-modify-write ($set of the whole array). Under high concurrency this could clobber concurrent settle calls. Consider `$push` for the settlements element instead.

payroll_run reads `pending_salary_deduction` at run-time but writes to a snapshot on the payroll row. If HR runs payroll first, then later a new /settle salary_deduction is posted, the older payroll row won't reflect the new schedule (works as intended, but should be documented).
seed_data_creation: Used the existing 10 released advances on staff TEST_AttachStaff_285c90 (ADV-26-0028..0050). Created a temporary non-admin user iter42_staff_<hex>@x.com for 403 tests. Created a payroll row for a random future month/year (2032-2040) that was PATCH-edited to basic=500000 and then paid — resulted in one salary expense transaction on that staff. Multiple small settlement entries appended to advances 42..0050 (values 1–100 each). No production/seed data mutated destructively.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter42 covers Advance Settlement Module + Payroll Auto-Deduction. Backend test at /app/backend/tests/test_iter42_settlement_payroll.py (18 tests). Two minor gaps noted in `backend_issues.minor`: (1) payroll_pay short-circuit when net<=0 misses advance-deduction loop, (2) TransactionOut model strips settlement-linking fields. Neither blocks the happy path. All 4 settle types + all payroll flows verified. Frontend UI (data-testid adv-settle-*, settle-modal, settle-type, settle-amount, settle-remarks, settle-submit-btn) works end-to-end.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature testing, not a bug fix. Feature verified working per spec.
